---
title: Scholar metadata for a delimited YAML bibliography
format: html
google-scholar: true
bibliography: references-delimited.yaml
_quarto:
  tests:
    html:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        - ['meta[name="citation_reference"][content*="citation_title=Cited reference;"]']
---

The bibliography is a YAML file wrapped in `---` delimiters, with a duplicated `title` key. Pandoc warns and keeps the last value, so the Scholar reference tags do too.

This article cites one work [@cited].
